# v1.4.2 - Vencord 1.15.14 build fix

### What's Changed

This release only fixes the build against current Vencord. Vencord 1.15.14 removed the deprecated `Button` and `Forms` exports from `@webpack/common`, which made the plugin fail to compile.

- **Buttons** now come from `@components/Button`, with `variant`/`size` props instead of the old `color`/`Button.Colors`/`Button.Sizes` API
- **Settings** use Vencord's `Heading` and `Paragraph` components instead of `Forms.FormTitle`/`Forms.FormText`
- **Sections** use plain `<section>` elements (the old `Forms.FormSection` was already just a shim)
- No functional changes: quest automation, queue and progress pills behave exactly as in 1.4.1
